holds.finding: A primary-forum comment claims the full result from logarithmic-saving estimates for all polylogarithmic shifts. The inspected literature supplies that saving for odd shifts only (Li, June 2026, Corollary 1.3), the reviewed c<2 result is partial, and no verified exact solution was located.
holds.required_resolution: Review of the claimed full result against the exact pinned type, then a new admission audit.

holds.finding: The pinned density-1/2 statement is obsolete or mis-sourced: upstream commit 73f8e05 (2026-09-13) replaces EHSNumbers_one_half with EHSNumbers_one, and the source paragraph states the authors' conjecture as density 1, distinguishing an early numerical trend near 0.5.
holds.required_resolution: A corrected statement through a source repin, then a new admission audit.

holds.finding: The pinned greedyUnitFractionRem may reuse odd denominators (2/3 becomes 1/3 + 1/3), while merged upstream PR 5806 removes each chosen denominator. The two formulations differ; neither is shown solved or false.
holds.required_resolution: Statement-correspondence review choosing the intended formulation, then a new admission audit.

holds.finding: The catalog’s sum includes primes. Under ordinary RH, Theorem 5 of Carneiro, Milinovich and Soundararajan supplies a prime in the interval, contributing 1. Independent verification of Alpöge’s announced RH proof is pending. Submissions are suspended during review.
holds.required_resolution: Independent verification of ordinary RH for the stated Mathlib proposition and a review of the catalog disposition.

holds.finding: The constant c is untyped in the pinned source and elaborates as Nat (upstream PR 5790), so the exact target is not the intended positive-real-c problem; the baseline canonical type re-exported at UID 10001 binds c : Nat. Upstream now types c as a positive real.
holds.required_resolution: A decision between retiring the defective statement and admitting a corrected real-c statement after a source repin, then a new admission audit.

holds.finding: Koch's June 2026 repository claims a full four-divisor bound, but its parts.ii endpoint (Formalization.lean at commit 230bf2c, lines 16518-16524) assumes an ExternalReconstructionSource hypothesis that is not instantiated there, and the manuscript could not be retrieved.
holds.required_resolution: Substantive review of whether the claim is unconditional and matches the exact pinned type, then a new admission audit.

holds.finding: Under GRH for Dirichlet L-functions, Theorem 1 of McGown, Treviño and Trudgian bounds the least prime primitive root modulo each prime p > 2791 by sqrt(p) − 2. Direct verification covers all 405 odd primes up to 2791. Submissions are suspended pending independent verification of Alpöge’s Dirichlet GRH claim.
holds.required_resolution: Independent verification of the stated result for Dirichlet L-functions and a review of its implication for the least prime primitive root.

holds.required_resolution: Reinstatement requires an explicit new admission review; prior proof and decision history remain preserved.
